_comment: Guided tour for the Batch-Analysis wizard. Steps point at real wizard rows and controls and wait for the user. Read by chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: One fit, many datasets
steps.text: Every item in the batch starts from the same template parameters, so the numbers that come out are comparable. That only works if the template is good: optimise one representative fit by hand before this. Six steps.

steps.title: Pick datasets already loaded
steps.text: Anything loaded in ChiSurf can join the batch. Hover a row to see the curve.

await.hint: Open Loaded data and tick the datasets to process.

steps.title: Or add files
steps.text: Files are loaded one by one and fitted after the loaded datasets. A folder adds everything in it.

steps.title: Choose the template
steps.text: The fit whose parameter values — and fixed flags — seed every run.

steps.title: Where the results go
steps.text: A CSV here; a DOCX report and a ZIP of per-run curve exports are written beside it.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: Each item is restored to the template, fitted, exported and captured. When it finishes, scan the Chi2r column in Results first — a jump marks a sample the template does not describe.
